# Getting help

Mossnote is a small volunteer project, so replies can take a few days. This page tells you where to look first and where to ask.

## Something is not working

1. Check the [README](../README.md) for how to run it and where your data lives. It also covers [phone access](../README.md#use-a-phone-or-tablet-while-you-play) and the [web version](../README.md#the-web-version).
2. If the app will not start, read the message it prints. Most start-up problems (a busy port, a locked journal, a failed integrity check) explain themselves and say what to do.
3. Search the [open and closed issues](https://github.com/rahulkaushal04/mossnote/issues?q=is%3Aissue) in case it is already known.
4. If it is still a mystery, open a [bug report](https://github.com/rahulkaushal04/mossnote/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). The form asks for what I need to reproduce it: your version, operating system, and whether you use Node, the downloaded program, phone access or the web version.

## You want to know how something works

The [README](../README.md) covers running it, configuration, backups and the layout of the source. If that does not answer it, open an issue and say what you were trying to do.

## You have an idea

Open a [feature request](https://github.com/rahulkaushal04/mossnote/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Read the "What it will not do" list in the [README](../README.md#what-it-will-not-do) first, since some ideas are ruled out on purpose.

## A security problem

Please do not use a public issue. Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Your data

Never paste real journal text into an issue, and never attach your database. If you need to show data, make some up. Mossnote's logs do not contain note text, but look over anything before you share it.
